scope: The standing 1936 Plaza Theatre and its restored façade, including the entry arcade, balcony, hip roofs, and the roof-mounted theatre sign.

originalReview.notes: Original street view of the double-faced roof sign, tiled roof, three front arches, chamfered upper balcony bays and buff concrete.
